title: A path helper gets a per-OS separator, and the guide follows

pr.title: Join paths with the separator of the target OS
pr.description: joinPath() gets an os parameter. Windows paths now use a backslash. The default stays posix, so the callers keep working. docs/guide.md shows the new call.

traps.why: The guide example is right: in the Markdown code block the TypeScript result string "out\\report.txt" is one backslash. The guide shows the new parameter and the per-OS separator, so no doc finding applies.
